messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: metering-alert detected token-count delta spike in eu1 (03:12-03:15 UTC). Delta ~6.8% above baseline; billing overage flags fired. Rule `metering.delta > 0.05` tripped. Please investigate and mitigate.

sarah (oncall): ack. I'm on it. @devon @priya can you join? Any initial impact estimates?

devon: oncall ack. pulling recent logs and metrics now.

sarah (oncall): thanks. seeing `overage.email` triggers in billing at 03:20. Suspect duplicate emission rather than real traffic growth.

priya: ACK. I'll check emitter and ingest-proxy traces. If duplicates, we can flip a short dedupe window as a mitigation.

devon: grabbing emitter tails now. cluster ids: emitter-eu1-3, ingest-proxy-eu1-1.

priya: quick peek at traces shows repeated batch ids being accepted by the emitter consumer.

devon: sample from emitter-eu1-3 logs:
```
[03:13:02] emitter-eu1-3 INFO sent batch id=0x7f8 size=120 tokens=20480
[03:13:05] emitter-eu1-3 WARN retrying batch id=0x7f8 err=timeout
[03:13:08] emitter-eu1-3 INFO sent batch id=0x7f8 size=120 tokens=20480
```

sarah (oncall): looks like retry+success got double-counted downstream. priya, can you apply temporary dedupe filter on ingest-proxy? e.g. dedupe-window 60s.

priya: on it. setting `dedupe_window_ms=60000` on ingest-proxy-eu1-1 and restarting the worker. applying now :wrench:

ops-bot: config update applied to ingest-proxy-eu1-1 by priya at 03:18 UTC. Rolling restart started.

devon: also seeing kinesis consumer latency spike at 03:12 which probably caused retries upstream. opening consumer lag dashboard.

emily-cs: FYI customer impact: 4 customers got automated overage emails at ~03:20 UTC because billing saw >10% variance. I'm pausing further auto emails and drafting a holding message.

sarah (oncall): good. @emily-cs please send a holding note: we're investigating potential false overage notices and will follow up. I'll update status page when we confirm reconciliation.

devon: consumer lag recovered by 03:22 and dedupe is dropping duplicate events. metric.delta now ~0.8% and trending down.

sarah (oncall): mitigation summary: temporary dedupe window applied; upstream consumer recovered; active monitoring in place. CS to hold credits until reconciliation is complete. :white_check_mark:

emily-cs: Sending hold message to affected accounts now. Draft subject: "Billing alert: investigating false overage notifications". Message: "We're investigating billing notifications you may have received. No action required; we'll follow up with credits if we confirm a false positive."

sarah (oncall): creating follow-up ticket for billing reconciliation and compensatory credits if duplicates confirmed. @devon please export correlated logs and attach. handoff to night rotation in 30m -> ping @alex-night if it regresses.

devon: exported logs to s3://redwood-incident-exports/1763333333/ and attached correlation ids in the ticket. notes added: emitter retry pattern + kinesis lag.

incident-bot: automated check PASS - metric.delta below threshold for 20m at 03:40 UTC. Marking incident state as resolved. :white_check_mark:

sarah (oncall): closing thread. Postmortem to include: dedupe hardening, emitter retry backoff improvements, and auto-email pause logic for billing anomalies. Thanks everyone.
file_notes: metering incident: dedupe mitigation and CS coordination
